entries.title: Joshua 2:1
segments: Shittim; a place in the plains of Moab, a few miles east of the Jordan.

entries.title: Joshua 2:6
segments: The roof of the house; their roofs were flat, and were places often resorted to for air, meditation, and rest.

entries.title: Joshua 2:7
segments: The fords; where they expected that the spies would cross over Jordan.

entries.title: Joshua 2:9
segments: The providences of God, as well as his word, often terrify the wicked; yet those terrors which do not lead them to repentance will do them no good, but will be forerunners of their destruction.

entries.title: Joshua 2:12
segments: Kindness to the people of God, and assistance rendered to them for his sake, are well pleasing to him, and secure his blessing.

entries.title: Joshua 2:14
segments:
Our life for yours; may God take our life if we do not save yours. 
 
We should be careful to promise only what is practicable and right; and when we make such promises, should conscientiously and faithfully fulfil them.

entries.title: Joshua 2:15
segments: She dwelt upon the wall; so that from her window she could let the men down outside of the city wall.

entries.title: Joshua 2:17
segments: We will be blameless; not under obligation to fulfil their engagement to her, unless she should do as they mentioned,

entries.title: Joshua 2:19
segments: His blood shall be upon his head; his death will be his own fault.

entries.title: Joshua 2:24
segments: When God abandons a people on account of their sins, all things conspire to work out their ruin.
